8 Jun 2023
Claim opened on a sideswipe during a lane change. The insured reported that the ohter vehicle drifted into their lane
as they were merging, and the claimant's representing attorney has requested that all contact go through their office.
1 Jul 2023
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is listed as a named driver and the vehicle was covered at the time of
loss. Damage to the vehicle is consistent with the reported impact, and the police report, scene photos, and the other
driver's statement all describe the collision the same way.
13 Sep 2023
Police and independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The claimant's
account has stayed the same in every conversation so far, including the initial recorded statement and the follow-up
call through counsel.
29 Sep 2023
Medical records describe a neck strain, which fits the type and focre of a side impact of this kind. No prior treatment to
the neck or upper back appears in the records we have obtained so far.
9 Nov 2023
Treatment followed a typiacl course, with physical therapy that tapered as the claimant's symptoms improved and the
treating provider noted steady progress. A neighbor mentioned seeing the vehicle with prior body damage several
weeks before the claimed date, so I am following up on that comment to see whether it can be verified or ruled out.
23 Jan 2024
No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in our files or in prior claim history, and the repair estimate matches the
damage shown in the photos. Pending the outcome of the neighbor follow-up, the file remains open with the injury
evaluation in progress.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
